text:
marta: quick sync 10: keystore privatelink onboarding decision. we hit multiple join failures when KMS policy hardened and cross-account grants were refused. need a long-term path that avoids per-grant churn.

luke: summary: current options = 1) automated scoped grants per peer account (fast but brittle), 2) privatelink-keystore endpoint in each region (clean, reduces KMS surface), 3) hybrid: short-lived grants + schedule privatelink rollout.

dev: for GPU fleets, privatelink gives predictable egress and no NAT costs. our warm-pool churn generated ~$1.8k/day extra NAT in last incident. privatelink infra ~ $300/mo per region + LB.

secops-bot: note: audit requirement A-9 wants key usage attribution and least-privilege. privatelink+audit-shipper fits better than broad grants.

marta: constraints: biz wants <2wk timeline for perm fix. infra has bandwidth for one region this sprint.

luke: proposal: short-term = scripted grants with 72h TTL for peered roles (automated via onboarding script). medium = deploy privatelink-keystore in us-west-2 and eu-central in 2 weeks. long-term = update onboarding to attach scoped grant if peer accepted, but prefer privatelink as default.

infra-bot: RB-2026-12 created. checklist: privatelink terraform module, route53 private zone entries, ALB certs, keystore proxy autoscaling, KMS key policy unchanged.

dev: can we reduce risk by having privatelink endpoint use the keystore-proxy principal and keep KMS policy strict? that way nodes never need cross-account Decrypt.

luke: yes. flow: node -> privatelink -> keystore-proxy (same-account principal) -> KMS Decrypt. Audit logs show proxy principal usage.

secops-bot: add requirement: access logs for proxy + KMS CloudTrail events retained 90d, alert if unexpected grantee ARN appears.

marta: timeline agreed: do scripted grants now for immediate recovery, spin up privatelink in us-west-2 this sprint, eu-central next sprint. owners: luke infra, dev rollout, secops verify audit.

luke: i'll open change window and run playbook. will post staging test results and cost delta.

marta: thanks. final: avoid changing key policies for broad account allow; prefer network-level isolation. closing.
